summary: The explainer reel features consistent flat 2D visuals and clear diagrammatic representations of mate preparation steps. Visual execution is generally stable, with minor framing and repetitive layout transitions between shots.

clean: Character interactions with props and yerba packs are positioned cleanly behind the counter.
Diagrammatic cut-section views of the mate gourd accurately depict water and yerba levels.
unclean: Shot 0: Includes a vertical transition fade artifact across the center frame.
Shot 2: Repeats the character framing from the previous shot without a clear visual variation.

clean: Captions and label pills are placed neatly in the upper visual margin.
Color palettes and character designs remain consistent across all shots.
unclean: Shot 10: Action movement during the shaking motion lacks dynamic visual cues.

issues.problem: Transition overlay creates a visible vertical stripe in the middle frame.
issues.fix: Ensure smooth shot transitions without persistent overlay artifacts.

issues.problem: Visual setup duplicates shot 1 without significant composition change.
issues.fix: Vary camera angle or character action when repeating dialogue context.

issues.problem: zoom too close (zoomed out by the guard) in 1 shot(s)
issues.fix: fix it at the source in the style (layout, camera plan, visual choice)

learnings.rule: Avoid static visual repetitions across consecutive short shots to maintain visual interest.
Maintain clear separation between top caption bars and character head outlines.
